section1.title: Guinea-Bissau: Good Samaritan School | Completed
section1.description: Our first partner project began in <purple>Bantandja</purple>, a small village in the far east of Guinea-Bissau, with around 646 inhabitants. The community’s reality is marked by more than <purple>70% illiteracy, a monthly income below 15 dollars, food insecurity, and an almost complete lack of basic infrastructure</purple>, such as schools and healthcare.
section1.description2: We at the <purple>OASIS Family</purple> joined forces with the <purple>Good Samaritan School</purple>, and thanks to the generosity of every Oasis partner, we were able to support the construction of a school that now welcomes underprivileged children from the region, offering education, meals, and a place of care and hope.
section1.description2b: There are words that come before any news, and this is one of them: <purple>thank you.</purple> Thank you for believing. Thank you for giving your time, your money, and your prayers to something that often happens far from your eyes, yet close to your heart. It is because of <purple>each one of you</purple> that we have something tangible to share through this project.
section1.description3: <purple>What your support covered:</purple> All the construction materials and labor required to complete this project were made possible through your contributions. Every brick, every bag of cement, every hour of work — everything was possible because of you. The well was the longest and most demanding stage. When we think about everything it took to get here, the word that comes to mind is: Gratitude. <purple>Today, there is an active school!</purple>

section2.title: STAGES OF THE BOM SAMARITAN SCHOOL

item1.title: Fundraising
item1.description:
Fundraising Campaign for Construction: 50,000€: ~R$318,595.92
  • Sound system for the classrooms
  • Construction of kitchen, cafeteria, bathrooms, and teachers' house
  • Artesian well for water supply
  • Purchase of furniture, including tables, chairs, cabinets, stove, refrigerator
  • Installation of solar panels for sustainable energy supply
  • Protective wall around the school

item2.title: Construction of School Infrastructure
item2.description: Build and equip the school to meet the needs of the children in the Bantaja region, from hiring local construction teams to overseeing the progress of the work to ensure quality and safety.

item3.title: Recruitment of Teachers
item3.description: Ensure a qualified team of teachers, aligned with the values and vision of Oasis, as well as validated by the Guinean educational curriculum.

item4.title: Admission of Students
item4.description: Admission of 150 children to the school in two shifts (morning and afternoon) starting with a screening process to ensure the inclusion of children in situations of greater vulnerability.

item5.title: Official Opening of the School
item5.description: Celebration of the school's inauguration with the local community, conducting continuous monitoring of the school's operations. A key focus on ensuring students receive meals during school hours.

item6.title: Sustainability of the Project
item6.description: Launch of the 'Educate a Child' campaign, where supporters contribute monthly to maintain a student's education and to expand the school, reaching more members of the community.
